title: EG 3.1 post-cutover acceptance
owner_instruction: Revise acceptance after owner-authorized completed Colab cutover; do not conflate migration acceptance with executor-admission readiness.
effective_scope: Release engineering and operating acceptance of EG 3.1 on Google Colab.

criteria.criterion: Only one active EG canonical writer on Colab
Old v3.0.1 runtime stopped, archived, and removed
One canonical database reused; task state and authenticated history preserved
Historical SATISFIED checkpoint 48 and current checkpoint 26 maintained
Audit authenticated chain, anchor, health and DB integrity PASS
SQLite dump, evidence backup, runtime rollback source safely retained
Source GitHub main synchronized and tests 131/131 PASS

executor_admission.requirement: A real executor and signing authority must be verified before enabling governed task execution; keep signed receipts and audit validation fail-closed.
executor_admission.colab_qemu_note: The QEMU instance is controlled by Colab host root. Its isolation must not be represented as an independently controlled production signer.

canonical_task.immutable_historical_gate: 07.01 PRE25 expired for NEW action; reconcile rather than replay
canonical_task.update_method: Only supported append-only, independently evidenced EG procedures; do not rewrite registry or audit history.

prohibited_interpretations: Operational PASS is not an EG VERIFIED_PASS receipt
Do not backdate a signed executor receipt for the completed cutover
Do not re-execute the physical cutover to satisfy an expired PRE
Do not reduce the existing original task's 16-step acceptance silently
Do not enable unsigned executor actions or configure dummy signing authority
scope_exclusions: Any new EG service deployment to QEMU
